### Nurse Magenta Heart (G4)

**Who she is:** A lavender-purple Earth-pony nurse seen at Ponyville Hospital in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. She is associated with the escalating hospital mix-up in **“Where the Apple Lies”** (season 6, episode 23, aired October 8, 2016), when young Applejack's lies about Granny Smith lead toward a supposed operation. The character index locates her at about **14:27**. [Character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares) · [Episode](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Where_the_Apple_Lies)

**Recognize her:** Muted orchid/lavender coat, very pale pink mane and tail, and pale cyan-blue eyes; one of the hospital's background nursing mares.

**Naming:** “Nurse Magenta Heart” is the name used by the fan-maintained character index; “Magenta Heart” is a shortened form. I found no verified on-screen naming, official merchandise name, or production credit establishing it as an official name. Her *appearance* is part of the G4 television continuity; the name's official status is unconfirmed.

**Voice and appearances:** No individually attributed spoken line or voice actor was verified. Treat her as an apparently non-speaking, uncredited background character. The only independently supported screen appearance is **“Where the Apple Lies”**; no separate comic, movie, or later-episode appearance or alter ego was verified. Do not mix her up with Nurse Redheart, Snowheart, Sweetheart, or Tenderheart. [Nurse-pony overview](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Nurse_ponies)

**Image:** [Nurse-ponies image gallery](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Nurse_ponies_images) lists a character-specific show still titled **“Nurse Magenta Heart ID S6E23.png”**. A broader verified hospital scene is embedded below; it is **not** a verified solo identification.
